headline: A$AP Rocky, the rapper reinventing masculinity
description: Like many of his peers, the global superstar grew up amid poverty and violence. Yet he stands apart in the world of rap. He rejects homophobia and misogyny, embraces being 'Mr. Rihanna' and is open about caring for his children. A Chanel ambassador, he is both an heir to the tradition of Black dandyism and the embodiment of a modern masculinity less bound by traditional norms.

description: Russian Colonel Azatbek Omurbekov's men carried out massacres of Ukrainians in the Kyiv region in March 2022. Le Monde traced his presence to a school in a Ukrainian village near the capital, Andriivka, from where he gave his orders.

headline: Vladimir Putin, a president sealed off in a Russia under lockdown
description: 'The Putin System' (1/3). The many 'siloviki,' officers drawn from Russia's security services, have seized power and are now omnipresent among the country's elites.
